text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Gained a little bit of weight, huh.
No choice then, guess I'll deal with it using "that".

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh!? Ace-senpai,
didn't you slim down quite a bit just since yesterday!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Is this the effect of that "thing"? It is, right?!
I wanna hear all about it~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What, you guys were listening?
Guess I've got no choice... By "that", I mean—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's a method everyone already knows~!
Come on, there's actually something special, right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Right, everyone knows about it.
...Which means anyone can do it, right?
Plus it's guaranteed weight loss! Nothing but perks!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, keep up!
I'll pace you so hard you'll completely forget your hunger.

Thanks in part to training hard alongside her juniors,
Katsuragi Ace got back in shape with zero rebound!
